$Comment: The toast and the sound a player gets when a hand-harvested pumpkin comes with Spices during Harvest
Feast. The file name is the moment id, and it is the Cue the spice row
(BonusRows/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Spice_Find.json) puts on its roll; a cue plays only when the
roll beside it handed something over. Key is a line in this pack's harvestfeast.world.lang, written
bare; Sound is any SoundEvent id, played where the player stands.
